name: Irina Volkov
bio:
Irina's journey into motorsport was a serendipitous event. Originally trained as an aerospace engineer, she found herself drawn to the fast-paced and innovative world of Formula 1 after attending a race in Sochi. The precision and demand for lightweight, durable materials resonated with her expertise. She quickly transitioned, mastering composite technology and specializing in carbon fiber applications within racing.

At Ferrari AF Corse, Irina is known for her meticulous approach and her ability to see the bigger picture. She doesn't just fix problems; she identifies the root cause and implements long-term solutions. Her calm demeanor under pressure is legendary, and she has a knack for mentoring junior technicians, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly bobbed with a slight wave
physical.description: Irina is of average height with a focused gaze and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and ideas.
Insists on using a specific brand of Russian tea during pit stops.
Has a habit of humming classical music while working on complex repairs.
